partition.why: test = the archived held-out nside-4 blocks (never used for fitting, priors, K, C or the Student-t); select = K and start choice; calib = Student-t fraction; fit = everything else

normalisation.why: C from the ALL-morphology south quasars, as for the current model, then applied unchanged to the PSF priors

fit.field_k_grid_why: K=64 won at the fixed floor 1e-3 because wide components had to tile the narrow stellar locus; with the floor chosen on the select cells the grid returns to 8-64 and is not extended further (a K=64 win is reported, not chased)
fit.contamination_why: the field sample holds unrecognised quasars ((1-kappa) of Sigma_Q per cone, kappa = known/expected); each source is weighted by 1 - P(unrecognised quasar) and Sigma_B subtracts them, so the field model describes non-quasars as the bkg hypothesis requires
fit.regularization_why: covariance floor chosen on the select cells: at K=32 south, select score -1.978 (1e-3), -1.786 (1e-4), -1.759 (1e-5); 'regularization' is only the floor of the initial contamination fit

photometry: dereddened: flux / mw_transmission, ivar * mw_transmission^2 (as the original Legacy model)

xdqso.why: original XDQSO-style design (relative fluxes, dereddened; field per r bin 17/19.5/20.5/21.5/22.5, original K=8 inside the grid; broad Gaussian outlier); only the PSF selection, test cells and unrecognised-quasar weighting are new
